reason: It's free and takes two minutes, and the one thing I never get from creator collabs is a real number of customers per post, so I'll list one offer and see what the PIN count says against my UPI settlements. If after a month the counter shows nothing, I stop.
objection: Customers won't bother showing a coupon, and my staff will forget to enter the PIN when it's busy, so the counter will undercount and I'll be judging creators on bad numbers.
would_change_my_mind: If the first month shows almost no redemptions, or if 'free' turns into me having to give big discounts or free services to creators, I'd drop it.
